Tokyo has invisible lines too.

  1. Sydney has its Latte Line. We went looking for Tokyo's, using the 2020 Census, OpenStreetMap and HotPepper restaurant listings, and found lines for jobs, ramen, konbini, gyudon, izakaya and more.
  2. Each line splits Tokyo in two. Orange is one side, blue is the other. Hover over any neighbourhood to see which side it's on.
  3. We check every line against random versions of Tokyo, so you can tell real patterns from coincidences.
